title: fix(service-messaging)!: in-app inbox messages are written only by the notification system; the generic data API and console refuse create, edit and delete
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgJSRdLSMks47MshHcmtLwgx)_
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYjDr5yXm5GpeerxkS

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：「站内消息」(`sys_inbox_message`) 改成和另外四个通知对象一样的引擎所有对象：控制台不再有新建、编辑、删除按钮；通用数据接口对新建、修改、删除返回 405；读取不变。管理员看到的三个字段说明改写成业务语言，「执行人」改名「触发人」；`sys_notification_delivery`、`sys_notification_receipt` 上同类开发者注释一并改写，覆盖全部 11 种语言。
- 为什么改：管理员在列表点「新建」以为是在发消息，实际写进去的这条消息没有通知编号，收件人永远标不成已读，红点一直挂到 90 天过期；收件人 ID 填错也照样返回成功。这违反了 ADR-0030「只有 emit() 能产生站内信」的约定。
- 风险与回滚：这是收窄（BREAKING）。之前用通用数据接口写站内信的调用方会收到 405，一方代码里没有这样的调用方。另一个行为变化：组织里有站内信时，删除组织不再因为这些站内信被拒绝，站内信保留到过期，和 `sys_notification` 现在的行为一致。回滚就是还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/inbox-message.object.ts`（`managedBy` 与 `enable.apiMethods` 两处）；`packages/runtime/src/notifications.hono.integration.test.ts` 新增的线上用例；`objects/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts` 新增的两条词表。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/notifications.hono.integration.test.ts`，预期 6 个用例全过，其中 [#32444] 用例断言 POST、PATCH、DELETE 都返回 405 `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`，并且通过 emit 写入的消息可以标记已读。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（落地前要过契约档复审）。

Fixes #32444

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — `git grep -n -iE "data/sys_inbox_message|create\(.sys_inbox_message|insert\(.sys_inbox_message" -- 'skills/**' 'content/docs/**'` has no hit (exit 1); the four pages that name the object (`skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md:372`, `content/docs/api/client-sdk.mdx:376`, two reference/release pages) describe it as the channel's materialization, which is what this PR enforces.

## What changes

ADR-0030 (`docs/adr/0030-notification-platform-convergence.md:24`): "**No producer writes an inbox/materialization row directly.**" The console's generic New form on `sys_inbox_message` was such a producer. The object declared no `managedBy` and no `enable` block, so the generic create, edit and delete affordances and the REST data door were all open.

Reproduced on `main` at `2513e3ad` on a fresh showcase boot, as the seeded platform admin: `POST /api/v1/data/sys_inbox_message` answered `201` (also for `user_id: 'usr_typo_does_not_exist'`). The bell served the row under its row id, `read: false`. `POST /api/v1/notifications/read {ids:[row id]}` answered `200 {readCount: 0}` and the row stayed unread. `POST /api/v1/notifications/read/all` flipped the three `emit()`-delivered rows (`readCount: 3`) and left this one unread. `PATCH` and `DELETE` on the row answered `200`.

- `inbox-message.object.ts`: `managedBy: 'engine-owned'` + `enable.apiMethods: ['get', 'list']`. This is the pair `sys_notification`, `sys_notification_receipt`, `sys_notification_delivery` and `sys_http_delivery` declare. On the same boot, an admin `POST` on each of those four answered `405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`. The bucket resolves every write affordance to `false`, so the console offers no New, Edit, Delete or Import. The registry strips the write verbs from the REST whitelist, and plugin-security's engine-owned write guard refuses a user-context engine write. The whitelist states the same answer on the object itself, as the siblings do. There is no redundant `userActions` block.
- Field help (`inbox-message.object.ts`): `notification_id` and `delivery_id` now describe the field for an administrator. `actor_id` is relabelled **Triggered By**, because it is the person whose action raised the notification, not a sender. The developer notes (`FK → sys_notification…`, `null until P1`, receipt suppression, digest construction) move into code comments.
- Same defect class, fixed in place (bounded in-place fix: same gate family, mechanical, file held by no other claim). The widened guard below reds them otherwise: `sys_notification_delivery.notification_id`, `sys_notification_receipt.notification_id` and `sys_notification_receipt.delivery_id` carried the same `FK → …` / `null until P1` notes.
- `objects/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`: two patterns join `DESIGN_RECORD_VOCABULARY`:
  - "an object-reference arrow": `FK`, or an arrow followed by a `sys_` name.
  - "a rollout-phase note": `P` plus a digit.

  Both are matched on the object name or the phase id, so a translated leaf (`外键 → sys_…`, `P1 之前为空`) is caught in every locale. `sys_inbox_message` joins the asserted population.
- Translations: the 11 bundles were regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`. Only the changed leaves were hand-translated in the 10 translated locales. The tool dropped the one source-hash entry each in `es-ES` and `ja-JP` whose leaf was a byte copy and is now translated.
- `packages/runtime/src/notifications.hono.integration.test.ts` (file surface widened by the seat for this one file): the harness now mounts the REST plugin (`createRestApiPlugin`), so the generic data door is on the wire. A module-top `import '@objectstack/metadata'` pays that load at collection (`check:test-source-alias`).

### Moved answer: organization delete

Engine-owned rows outlive an organization delete (`engine-cascade-planning.ts` `outlivesOrganization`). An organization that holds inbox rows is no longer refused `DELETE_RESTRICTED` for them. The rows are kept, naming the deleted organization, until their 90-day expiry. That is what the four sibling objects' rows already do. Accepted by the seat's ruling and declared in the changeset. Whether engine-owned rows should be swept on organization delete is a family question the seat files separately.

### Census: first-party writers (none refused)

| Writer | Door / context | After |
|---|---|---|
| inbox channel, `inbox-channel.ts` `send` | engine insert under `FAN_OUT_SYSTEM_CONTEXT` (`isSystem: true`) | passes |
| 90-day TTL reaper | system | passes |
| `packages/runtime/src/notifications.hono.integration.test.ts` bulk seed | context-less engine insert | passes |
| `service-messaging/src/actor-reference.pin.test.ts` | context-less engine insert | passes |
| console (`sharedUserFeeds.ts`, `useHomeInbox.ts`) | reads only | unaffected |
| seeds | none write the object | n/a |

Member permission sets were already read-only on this object (`plugin-security` default sets, `allowCreate/Edit/Delete: false` with `_self` select RLS), so the door was reached by an administrator.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/notifications.hono.integration.test.ts`: new case `[#32444] the generic data door refuses an inbox write with 405; the channel-written row stays markable read`, over a real hono socket.
  - `POST`, `PATCH` and `DELETE` on `/api/v1/data/sys_inbox_message` each answer `405` with `code: 'OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED'`.
  - Afterwards the user still has exactly one row, the channel's, with its title unedited.
  - CONTROL: the `emit()`-written row is listed unread, then `POST /notifications/read` answers `readCount: 1` and `unreadCount` drops to 0.
- `objects/inbox-message-mine-view.test.ts`: new top-level describe `sys_inbox_message write door`. It pins `managedBy === 'engine-owned'`, no `userActions`, and resolved affordances `create/edit/delete/import: false`. It also pins that `apiExposureDenialReason(enable, create|update|delete) === 'method-not-allowed'` (the predicate the REST door wraps), with `get`/`list` open.
- `objects/admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts`: matcher cases for both new patterns, in English and Chinese. The existing `P3 digest middleware` example now also names the phase.

<details><summary>Ablation (once, on the wire pin)</summary>

Two partial ablations were run before the full one; their results are reported as found:

- **Removing only `apiMethods` keeps the pin green.** Replacing it with `['get','list','create','update','delete']`, building, and confirming with the dist preflight still gave 6/6. Under `engine-owned` the registry's `reconcileManagedApiMethods` strips the write verbs from the whitelist, so the bucket alone already answers 405 on REST. The whitelist is declared anyway to match the siblings, and it is the half that holds if the bucket ever moves.
- **The full ablation removes both halves**, as nested `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` mutations of `inbox-message.object.ts`:
  - `managedBy` was replaced with `['ablation_32444_bucket'].includes('on') ? 'engine-owned' : undefined`.
  - `apiMethods` was replaced with `(['get','list','create','update','delete'] as const).filter((m) => m !== ('ablation_32444_marker' as string))`.
  - Then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging build`. `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` reported `✓ dist/: marker present in 2 built files` for both markers.
  - Result: `× [#32444] the generic data door refuses an inbox write with 405 …`, `AssertionError: expected 201 to be 405`, `Tests 1 failed | 5 passed (6)`.
- **Restore leg.** `ablation-replace: ok restored: blob == HEAD (43ecf16dc1e6) and git diff HEAD is empty` for both mutations. A rebuild then gave `--absent` `✓ dist/: marker absent from all 6 built files` for both markers, and `Tests 6 passed (6)`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `delivery_id` is inert on inbox rows: no writer ever sets it (the inbox channel's row omits it). The same holds on receipts: both receipt writers (`inbox-channel.ts`, `messaging-service.ts`) write `delivery_id: null`. The help text now says it is not filled in; removing or wiring the column is out of scope and goes to the seat.
- #6448 (filed, dormant) is the receipt-key gap that makes a null-`notification_id` row unmarkable. Closing this door removes the reach to it that was found here.
- The send-an-in-app-message entry point stays with decision #32445.

| `POST /api/v1/notifications/read` | `200 {readCount: 0}`, row still unread |

| `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_inbox_message/:id` | `200` |
| `POST` on each of the four siblings | `405 OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` |

</details>
